paragraphs: He is mentioned in Gittin 56a. They challenged Rava: But did not Avram Hozaah recite, “They do not exact payment, etc.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The source cites Gittin 56a. The Avram Choza’ah teaching used to challenge Rava appears at 50a in the William Davidson vocalized text; it is not on the retrieved 56a. The source’s locator is retained. תני introduces a recited baraita.

The whole Davidson Gittin 50a paragraph explicitly uses Avram Choza’ah’s recited teaching to challenge Rava. Hyman’s 56a is retained alongside that digital location. The current note remains verbatim as its earlier lookup report; this pass makes no new absence claim for 56a or printed-locator repair and imports no additional legal material.
